reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: It’s on my repeat purchase. Compared to other niacinamide products, this one doesnt sting. I noticed that my skin is brighter and my blemishes fade easily.
reviews.zh: 呢個我會回購。比起其他 niacinamide 產品，呢款唔會刺刺哋。我發覺皮膚提亮咗，色斑都易退咗。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: I haven't used long enough to see the differences in my dark spots but overall the cream is very moisturizing and absorbs well.
reviews.zh: 我未用夠耐，所以暫時未睇到對色斑有咩分別，但整體嚟講，呢款霜好保濕，吸收得好好。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: So far I haven’t seen much difference as I just started using it. The product is more of a gel constancy so it dries fast which I like. It’s ligh weight and I don’t feel oily throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 到目前為止，我未見到太大分別，因為我啱啱開始用。呢件產品比較似gel狀質地，所以乾得快，我幾鍾意。佢好輕，我成日都唔覺得笠。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: This product is amazing. It got rid of my blemishes so quick. I had a few on my face and could not get rid of them no matter what. Friend recommend this and it works wonders.
reviews.zh: 呢件產品勁正。佢好快就幫我清走咗啲瑕疵。之前我塊面有幾粒，點搞都清唔甩。朋友推介呢件，真係好work。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: Didn’t work for me but may work for the others
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講唔work，但可能啱其他人。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: This is a brand new product from the ROUND LAB line and it has a nice texture and absorption, but I haven't seen much change in helping or hurting me skin.
reviews.zh: 呢件係ROUND LAB嘅全新產品，質地同吸收力都唔錯，但我未見到對皮膚有咩明顯幫助或者傷害。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: Round Lab has done it again! This cream is lightweight, moisturizing, and brightening. It also has a light and suitable citrus scent. I am a big fan of this brand's creams and this one is also amazing.
reviews.zh: Round Lab又再一次做到！呢款面霜輕盈、保濕、仲有提亮效果。佢仲有陣淡淡嘅柑橘香味，好啱用。我係呢個品牌面霜嘅大粉絲，呢款一樣勁正。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB VITA NIACINAMIDE DARK SPOT CREAM 50ML
reviews.text: I love this cream. I've been using it for 3 weeks and I really like the texture, is very lightweight. I use it in the mornings and has helped to reduce my blemishes around my nose. It also pairs very well with sunscreen, I just give it a minute to dry (but I do this with every step in my skin care routine). You don't need a big amount to cover your face and neck. I also have sensitive skin and it hasn't irritate me.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款面霜。我用咗3個星期，真心鍾意佢嘅質地，好輕。我朝早用，有助減退鼻附近嘅瑕疵。佢同防曬好夾，我只係等佢乾多一分鐘（不過我每個護膚步驟都係咁）。唔使搽好多已經可以cover塊面同頸。我都有敏感肌，用完冇刺激到我。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
